sentences.en: The rocket experienced an ejection of fuel during launch.
sentences.zh: 火箭在发射时燃料发生了喷出。

sentences.en: He suffered from the ejections of gas after eating spicy food.
sentences.zh: 他吃了辛辣食物之后放出了气体。

sentences.en: The company faced a product ejection due to quality issues.
sentences.zh: 由于质量问题，公司面临产品被剔除的风险。
